message: 遭遇ふたたび

name: Paqy
message: 「Fatty, loli, snob, idiot, Soltia, Bylous」

name: Synn
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Those are the Seven Demon Generals who've shown up so far」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you trying to say there's one more left?」

name: Paqy
message: 「No way. If someone shows up in front of you, Master Synn, it's gonna be Soltia, Bylous, or the unknown Demon General, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「That would be the case, yeah」

name: Paqy
message: 「You felt how strong Soltia and Bylous were the other day, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You'd better assume the remaining one is on the same level. Do you really think you can win alone?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, out of everyone, I have the best chance of winning... I think」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmph」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, we don't even know if Nanaka will be able to summon the Guardian Angel's power next time...」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's been totally fine ever since then」

name: Synn
message: 「True, but she's had trouble twice in a row when it really counted...」

name: Paqy
message: 「So you're saying you'll head 'em off and take 'em down first?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if I can't beat them, I can at least gauge their strength and get away」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you really that worried about Soba?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-well, she is my childhood friend. I mean, it's not like I'm only worried about Nanaka!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't look that way to me」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-you're just imagining things」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, saying it's just Soba was going a bit too far」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what Ms. Melilot was doing here the other day?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Pulled the wool over their eyes」

name: Synn
message: 「I doubt Helena would ever approve of wandering around late at night. It makes you wonder, doesn't it」

name: Voice
message: 「What are you doing at this hour?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa!」

name: Melilot
message: 「What are you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Patrolling!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I heard the chairwoman put a stop to that」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, yes, but... I just couldn't accept it」

name: Melilot
message: 「Go back at once. I'll tell the chairwoman」

name: Synn
message: 「...Can you really tell her?」

name: Synn
message: 「She'll find out you were here at this hour too, Melilot?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Go back」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena knows about this too, doesn't she?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Go back」
